_help.about: The Cat's talent tree. It starts at the top and grows downward: from the start node four paths lead down (Witchcraft = poison, bleed and lightning; Nine Lives = health, block and healing; Prowler = trinkets, movement and luck; Reaper = weapon damage, crits and stuns), and every talent unlocks from the row above it. Talents last for one run only: the tree resets when a run ends. Entries with "disabled": true are skipped.
_help.currencies: totem = Totem of Power (one per altar claimed, at most 5 per level). spoon = Alien Spoon (one per alien invasion repelled, at most 1 per level); spoons buy the alien talents in the "alien" section below. Each talent costs one currency.
_help.groups: Colors and names for areas of the tree: id, name, color. Purely visual; points spent per group are shown at the top.
_help.talents.x / y: Position on the tree grid (x grows right, y grows down). The start node sits at the top; keep every talent below the ones it requires so the tree reads top to bottom. Any whole numbers work; the view sizes itself to fit.
_help.talents.start: true = the free starting node. It is always learned and its stats always apply.
_help.talents.big: true = a big talent: drawn larger. Big talents usually carry an effect with a downside.
_help.talents.cost: Currency per rank. Every talent costs 1 (a Totem of Power, or an Alien Spoon for alien talents).
_help.talents.maxRank: How many times it can be learned (default 1).
_help.talents.stats: Stats gained per rank. Stat keys are listed in characters.json.
_help.talents.effect: Optional special effect: {"id": ..., plus any numbers to override}. Effects and their numbers: ragingBull (chance, buff, extend, bleedMult; you can never poison), experiencedPrecision (doublecritMult; crits cannot cause bleeding), livingFlesh (maxHpMult, regen = share Buff ids are in status_effects.json.
_help.talents.text: What the effect does, shown in the tooltip.
_help.talents.downside: The effect's drawback, shown in red in the tooltip.
_help.talents.icon: Pixel icon. The list is in upgrades.json.
_help.talents.requiresAny: Learn at least one of these first. This is how the tree connects: link each node to its neighbours.
_help.talents.requires: Learn all of these first, e.g. ["sharp_claws"], or {"id": "sharp_claws", "rank": 3} for a higher rank.
_help.talents.minSpent: Points (of any currency) that must already be spent in the tree this run.
_help.lines: A line is drawn from every talent listed in requires or requiresAny.
_help.talents.rules: Talents made without code (the talent creator: tools/talents, served by python3 tools/serve.py). A list of {"when": trigger, "chance", "every" (every Nth time), "cooldown", "if": [conditions], "then": [actions]}. A condition is {"check": id, "not": true to flip it, ...its numbers}, an action {"do": id, ...its numbers}. Any number can be a list with one value per rank ([1, 1.5, 2]). Triggers: hit, crit, kill, attack, damaged, block, lowHealth (threshold), heal, dash, trinket, levelUp, bleed, poison, status (status), interval (seconds), still (seconds), distance (meters), dayStart, dawn, bossAppears. Conditions: targetStatus, targetKind, targetHealth, targetEnemy, targetDistance, wasCrit, myHealth, myShield, myBuff, myStatus, moving, enemiesNear, weaponClass, weapon, damageType, trinketReady, dashReady, killsRecent, hitRecently, bossAlive, level, map, dayTime, inDungeon, darkness, chance. Actions: explode, strike, lightning, projectiles, status, poison, bleed, holyFire, spread, zone, knockback, execute, heal, shield, buff (an id, or a new buff written in place: {name, icon, color, duration, stats}), invulnerable, cleanse, dashCharge, dash, trinketCooldown, trinketEffect, extraAttack, empower, resetCooldowns, drop, gain, magnet, text, sound, flash, shake, ring. Every number and its default is listed in js/rules.js; the talent creator shows them all.
_help.talents.conditionalStats: Stats that only count while conditions hold: [{"if": [conditions], "stats": {stat: value per rank}}]. Checked five times a second.
_help.talents.hitBonus: More damage on weapon hits that pass conditions: [{"if": [conditions], "more": 0.3}] (0.3 = 30% more, multiplying everything else).
_help.talents.text (rules): Talents with rules and no text get one written from their rules.

talents.name: Toxic Touch
talents.text: Poison chance above 100% applies extra poisons with a single hit (150% = one poison, plus a 50% chance of a second).

talents.name: Stout Heart
talents.text: When you are hit, gain a shield worth 5% of your max health for 5 seconds. 7 second cooldown.

talents.name: Adrenaline Rush
talents.text: When you are hit, your trinket recharges 100% faster for 3 seconds. 5 second cooldown.

talents.name: Flurry
talents.text: Every 5th attack strikes twice.
talents.desc: Paw, paw, paw, paw, PAW PAW.

talents.name: Open Wounds
talents.text: Your hits always crit against bleeding monsters.

talents.name: Battle Fury
talents.text: Blocking grants you Bloodlust for 3 seconds. 10 second cooldown.

talents.name: Restless Waiting
talents.text: While your trinket is recharging: +20% movement speed and +30% increased armor.

talents.name: Killing Spree
talents.text: While you have killed at least 5 monsters in the last 4 seconds: +10% movement speed and +10% attack speed.

talents.name: Reaper's Harvest
talents.desc: One more blade for the field.

talents.name: Crushing Blow
talents.text: Every 5th attack, your next hit always stuns and deals double damage.

talents.name: Static Fur
talents.desc: Never pet a cat on a dry day.

talents.name: Raging Bull
talents.text: Killing a bleeding monster has a 30% chance to grant Raging Bull for 10 seconds: every bleed you have inflicted lasts 5 seconds longer, and bleeds deal double damage.

talents.name: Thorned Guard
talents.text: Blocking an attack takes the strongest bleed on a monster within 3 meters of you and spreads it to every monster within 5 meters of that one. 15 second cooldown.

talents.name: Chain Lightning
talents.text: Ricochets become rays of lightning that strike instantly, and each one deals 50% bonus elemental damage.

talents.name: Guarded
talents.text: If you were hit in the last 4 seconds: +10% block chance.

talents.name: Living Flesh
talents.text: You regenerate 10% of your max health every second.
talents.downside: Your max health is cut in half.

talents.name: Bomb Battalion
talents.text: Every time you block, you explode for 1000% of your max health in a huge radius.

talents.name: Hiss!
talents.text: When you fall below 50% health, every monster within 5 meters is stunned for 5 seconds. 2 minute cooldown.

talents.name: Trophy Hunter
talents.text: Killing a rare monster (elite, rare, invader or rare golem) shields you for 20% of your max health for 10 seconds, or until the shield breaks.

talents.name: Nettle Snare
talents.text: Rooting a monster instantly poisons it 5 times, each stack based on your weapon damage.

talents.name: Purring Wrath
talents.text: 10% of the healing you receive is multiplied by 10 and dealt to every monster within 3 meters of you.

talents.name: Ninth Life
talents.desc: Once per run, a killing blow leaves you at half health instead.

talents.name: Divine Finale
talents.text: When your trinket's effect ends, you explode in a 5 meter radius, setting every monster hit on holy fire.

talents.name: Feline Swiftness
talents.text: Dashing grants Feline Swiftness for 5 seconds: +15% movement speed.

talents.name: Hunter's Momentum
talents.text: Your bonus movement speed also counts as increased crit chance (+20% movement speed = +20% increased crit chance).

talents.name: Shadow Leap
talents.desc: Dashing through monsters claws them on the way past.

talents.name: Cold Shoulder
talents.text: Monsters near you are slowed by 10%.

talents.name: Busy Paws
talents.text: Each monster you kill takes 1 second off your trinket's cooldown (at most once every 2 seconds).

talents.name: Curiosity
talents.desc: Every level up shows one more blessing.

talents.name: Sharp Claws
talents.desc: The fence post out back has seen better days.

talents.name: Golem Breaker
talents.desc: Stone cracks like any other bone.

talents.name: Experienced Precision
talents.text: Crit chance above 100% becomes the chance to Doublecrit, dealing your crit damage twice.
talents.downside: Your critical strikes cannot cause bleeding.

talents.name: Storm Caller
talents.text: Your attacks have a 5% chance to loose a lightning bolt that always chains, jumping between 25 monsters. Each jump deals elemental damage and shocks.

talents.name: Iron Hide
talents.text: While you wield a melee weapon, every 10 seconds you gain a shield worth 10% of your max health for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Giant Slayer's Frenzy
talents.text: When you kill more than 2 bosses within 2 seconds, gain Bloodlust for 5 seconds.

talents.name: Swordsman's Guard
talents.text: While you wield a sword, +1% block chance for every monster you killed in the last 4 seconds, up to +25%.

talents.name: Borrowed Time
talents.text: When you fall below 20% health, Grandpa's Pocket Watch goes off on its own: time stops around you. 10 minute cooldown.

talents.name: In the Thick of It
talents.text: While at least 50 monsters are within 5 meters of you: +25% increased armor.

talents.name: Festering Wounds
talents.text: +20% bleed chance. Your bleeds last twice as long, and every second they hurt more: up to 3x damage in their last second.
talents.desc: It never closes. It only gets worse.

talents.name: Toxic Detonation
talents.text: Every 20 seconds, your next hit on a poisoned monster bursts its poisons: an explosion dealing 2x the damage per second of all its poison stacks, 1 meter wide per stack (10 stacks: 10 meters).

talents.name: Ball of Yarn
talents.text: After every 5th attack, your next attack always ricochets, with +10 bounces.

talents.name: Matted Fur
talents.desc: Tangled, filthy, and surprisingly hard to bite through.

talents.name: Catch of the Day
talents.text: Fish heal you for 50% more.

talents.name: Sanctified Hide
talents.text: 10% of the holy damage you deal (holy fire, holy explosions, holy ground) becomes a shield, up to 25% of your max health. It fades 4 seconds after you last feed it.
talents.desc: The light looks after its own.

talents.name: Unbreakable
talents.text: Getting stunned or rooted gives you a shield of 30% of your max health for 6 seconds (1 minute cooldown).
talents.desc: Pin a cat down. See what happens.

talents.name: Cat Scratch Fever
talents.text: Every poison stack you inflict also deals 1% of your max health per second.

talents.name: Plague Feast
talents.text: Killing a poisoned monster heals you 1 health for every poison stack on it.

talents.name: Poisoned Chalice
talents.text: Monsters with your poison on them cannot heal: their healing (Regenerating, Vampiric) hurts them instead.

talents.name: Riposte
talents.text: Blocking charges your next attack: 3x damage and +150% area, but 50% less attack speed for it. 15 second cooldown.

talents.name: Sacred Ward
talents.text: Using your trinket makes you invulnerable for 2 seconds.

talents.name: Tinkerer
talents.text: Every 2 minutes of fighting you earn a free item level upgrade at the workbench.
talents.desc: Idle paws are the workbench's playthings.

talents.name: Pent-Up Fury
talents.text: Using your trinket charges your next hit: it explodes for 500% of its damage around the monster (30 second cooldown).

talents.name: Dungeon Delver
talents.text: Going down into a dungeon gives you a shield of 20% of your max health for 30 seconds.
talents.desc: Cats are made for dark places.

talents.name: Killer Instinct
talents.text: Every 5th attack is always a critical hit.

talents.name: Blood Inheritance
talents.text: When a boss dies bleeding, its bleed passes on to the nearest monster.
talents.desc: The big ones always leave something behind.

alien._help: Alien talents: powerful talents with no tree, bought with Alien Spoons on the Alien Talents tab of the inventory (I). Pick them in any order; requires lists talents that must be learned first. group sets the column (weapon, survival, bleeding). effect, text, downside, icon and desc work like the tree's talents; effect numbers can be overridden here.

talents.name: Bane of Legends
talents.text: 20% more damage to bosses. Bosses that fall below 10% health are executed.

talents.name: Otherworldly Thirst
talents.text: Your next attack heals you for 10% of your max health. 30 second cooldown.

talents.name: Zealotry
talents.text: +10% attack speed for every monster you killed in the last 4 seconds, up to +100%.
talents.downside: Taking damage resets it and puts Zealotry on a 10 second cooldown.

talents.name: Unending Zealotry
talents.text: Zealotry also grants the same amount of increased crit chance, and its cap rises to +200%. While Zealotry is active, Otherworldly Thirst recharges twice as fast.

talents.name: Burning Bridges
talents.text: You set the ground behind you on fire. Monsters in it burn for 6% of your max health 4 times a second, as elemental damage that cannot poison or bleed.

talents.name: Fortitude
talents.text: Your block chance also increases your max health by the same percentage.

talents.name: Infused Flesh
talents.text: Your weapon deals 5% of your max health as extra elemental damage with every hit.

talents.name: Divine Shield
talents.text: Blocking a hit that would have taken more than 20% of your max health wreathes you in holy fire for 5 seconds: every second it deals the blocked damage to monsters within 3 meters. 6 second cooldown.

talents.name: Savage Hits
talents.text: Your bleeds deal damage multiplied by your crit multiplier.
talents.downside: Only critical strikes can cause bleeding.

talents.name: Phlebotomist
talents.text: Bleeding monsters have a 10% chance to burst in a violent spray of blood when they die, spreading their bleed to every monster within 5 meters.

talents.name: Experimenting on Humans
talents.text: Monsters that are both bleeding and poisoned are rooted until one of them wears off.

talents.name: Bleeding from the Ears
talents.text: Your bleeds have a 10% chance to cripple: the monster is slowed by 70% and leaves a trail of blood for as long as it bleeds. The trail hurts monsters in it for 10% of the bleed's damage.
